label: Higher Loneliness, Lower Depressive and Anxiety Symptoms
summary: A female respondent with graduate-level education who reports relatively higher loneliness but lower depressive and anxiety symptoms. She spends 1–3 hours in the relevant activity context. This profile is based on a training-split group of 317 respondents.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate or above education; 1–3 hours in the relevant activity context.
behavior_markers: Reports higher loneliness on the UCLA-8 scale (mean 1.30).
Reports lower depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9 (mean 0.86).
Reports lower anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7 (mean 0.91).
Engages in the relevant activity for 1–3 hours.
tone: Neutral, descriptive, and evidence-grounded; avoids clinical interpretation or causal claims.

label: Elevated Distress Profile
summary: This profile describes a group with higher loneliness and elevated depressive and anxiety symptoms relative to the broader sample. The mean scores indicate a pattern of moderate psychosocial distress across all three indicators.
demographic_anchor: Female; graduate degree or above; more than 5 hours (of unspecified daily activity, as reported in the profile).
behavior_markers: More than 5 hours of the referenced activity
tone: Cautious, clinical, and evidence-grounded; avoids overgeneralization beyond the provided means and demographic anchors.
